item.g:title: Handmade Crochet Shadow Monster Baby Hat - 0-3 months
item.g:description: Handmade Crochet Shadow Monster Baby Hat. 5 sizes available: 0 - 3 months 3 - 6 months 6 - 9 months 9 - 12 months 12 - 18 months Unsure about which size to order? The hat is stretchy like a beanie. In general, I would recommend to get the next larger size but if you send me a message with your child's head circumference measurement I can make a personalized recommendation! :) Note: Custom colors are available upon request. Send your request through the website's contact form after completing your purchase. Handmade to order by Florence Mae Gifts in Maryland. Free U.S. shipping.
